# Peru

> [!summary] Data available
> Good dish coverage for its size: [[FmLAMA]] 44 dishes (rank 17 in the dataset), [[WorldCuisines]] 22, plus 121 [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] recipes. No FCT; plants via [[CMAUP]] (170), [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] (159) and [[NPASS]] (35), and a small [[Exposome-Explorer]] set (77 rows).

## Foods & dishes
- Dish inventories: [[FmLAMA]] 44 dishes (e.g. ceviche, ocopa, suspiro de limeña; ingredients, no amounts); [[WorldCuisines]] 22 dishes (6 Peru-only, incl. Chinese-Peruvian arroz chaufa, tallarín saltado); [[World Wide Dishes]] 1 (shared).
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 121 recipes tagged `peruvian`.
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈240 recipes in v1; not released.
- Backlog: [[RecetasDeLaAbuela]] (priority 3, open-download): Spanish-language recipes labelled by Spanish-speaking country; per-country counts not known yet.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table in the vault or `Backlog/`; [[USDA FoodData Central]] is the fallback.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 170 plants on the map; [[NPASS]] 35 specimen pairs.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 159 ethnobotany records, 127 taxa. [[KNApSAcK Family]] has a World-map page for it (edible/medicinal species records), not scraped, so no count in the vault.
- [[Exposome-Explorer]]: 77 concentration rows.
- Compound → effect chains via the [[Global]] backbones ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]]).

## Gaps
- No Peruvian FCT; Andean crops (quinoa, oca, maca, native potatoes) need composition data beyond USDA.
- No Quechua/Aymara food knowledge (no BLEnD culture).
